title: Economic and event calendar in Asia 31 August 2026 - China official PMIs
description: It's a packed data agenda ahead with the priority item Chinese PMI data.  Setting the stage for the session ahead is this renewed hostility: U.S. forces have struck two Iranian launchers near Strait of Hormuz China's National Bureau of Statistics releases its official August Purchasing Managers' Indices on Monday at 9:30am Beijing time (01:30 GMT/2130 US Eastern time Sunday), with the manufacturing print due to show whether a contraction that deepened sharply in July has begun to ease.
